title: plan_rename input

snapshot_id.description: Default is the repository's current snapshot.

oneOf.description: A symbol by name and file, in place of its id.

name.description: The name a lean row shows (Driver.escape), or the plain name (escape); it must name one symbol in the file.

path.description: The repository-relative path of the file that declares the symbol.

subject_id.description: The symbol to rename: its id, or { name, path }. Give subject_id or key.

key.description: The symbol to rename by its stable_key, in place of subject_id.

new_name.description: The name it is to have; the plan says when a symbol of the same scope already has it.

include_workspace.description: true adds the calls and references in the other repositories of this repository's workspaces that reach the symbol, or a member renamed with it, through a package it builds, read from the workspace's sealed link file; each site carries its repository. A public export then lists those consumers instead of saying none outside the repository are listed.

envelope.description: compact leaves out the snapshot-wide parts of the envelope (unresolved reasons, standing limitations) that an earlier answer from the same snapshot already gave; query-specific limits stay. Over MCP, answers after the first full one per snapshot are compact unless full is asked for.

description: A read-only plan of every site a rename of one symbol must change, with file and line: its declaration, calls, references, import and export specifiers, and the implementations and overrides that must be renamed with it, each observed; seams that bind it by name (an OpenAPI operationId, a gRPC or GraphQL handler, an FFI name, a dependency-injection or serialised string key, a doc mention), each inferred and to be reviewed; and calls that did not resolve but might reach it, apart. Changes no file.
